description_zh: 古代文献在奥古斯都统治下系统性地将塞克斯图斯·庞培称为「海盗」（praedo）和「匪帮头目」。此为系统性政治宣传——塞克斯图斯指挥的是正规舰队，控制领土，铸币自称Pius（孝子），并拥有元老院的正式任命。现代学术已充分揭示此标签的意识形态性质。
description_en: Ancient sources under the Augustan regime systematically label Sextus Pompey a 'pirate' (praedo) and 'brigand chief.' This is systematic political propaganda — Sextus commanded a regular fleet, controlled territory, minted coins with the title Pius, and held official senatorial appointments. Modern scholarship has fully demonstrated the ideological nature of this label.
review_note: 此标签的去神话化是当代塞克斯图斯·庞培研究的核心贡献（Hadas 1930, Powell and Welch 2002）。

description_zh: 现代通俗历史叙述倾向于将塞克斯图斯·庞培浪漫化为抵抗后三头暴政的「最后共和派」。此形象虽较「海盗」标签更为正面，但同样为后世的建构——需注意避免将现代政治价值观投射于古代人物。
description_en: Modern popular histories tend to romanticize Sextus Pompey as 'the last Republican' resisting triumviral tyranny. While more positive than the 'pirate' label, this image is equally a later construction — caution is needed against projecting modern political values onto an ancient figure.
